import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Kill any previous build processes
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pkill -f 'docker-compose build' 2>&1 || true")
time.sleep(2)
# Try single-step build: just build the server first
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && docker build -t arelorian-engine:test -f Dockerfile --target builder . 2>&1 | tail -20 &")
print("Build started in background")
time.sleep(5)
client.close()
EOF
